name: Japan Petroleum Exploration Co.,Ltd.
summary: Japan Petroleum Exploration Co., Ltd. and its subsidiaries explore for, develop, produce and distribute crude oil, natural gas and other energy sources in Japan, Canada, Russia, Iraq and elsewhere. At home it manages oil and gas fields onshore and offshore in Hokkaido, Akita, Yamagata and Niigata, and owns a natural gas pipeline network. It is also known as JAPEX.
